note: The Baker River half of Modern America's Riverbrook & Baker River in Rumney, off Quincy Road, with a river beach for swimming, fishing and tubing. The sites along the river are tent sites; the water-and-electric RV sites sit a lane back behind a wooded strip. Riverbrook, its sister campground about a mile west on Route 25, has the main office, and Campspot books both on one listing. About 37 of its 61 sites are sold by the night; the rest go to seasonal campers. --Claude
